checks.text: With no inputs, the page shows the heading "Salary Calculator", the result summary line "Net Pay: $0.00", and the breakdown table header row containing "Deduction" and "Amount".

Typing "50000" in the field labelled "Gross Annual Salary" and clicking the button "Calculate" updates the result summary to show "Net Pay: $37,500.00" and adds a row in the breakdown table with "Federal Tax" and "$12,500.00".
After setting "Gross Annual Salary" to "50000" and "State Tax" to "5000", clicking "Calculate" shows "Net Pay: $32,500.00" in the result summary and a breakdown row for "State Tax" with "$5,000.00".

Setting "Gross Annual Salary" to "100000", "Federal Tax" to "20000", "State Tax" to "10000", and "Other Deductions" to "5000", then clicking "Calculate" shows "Net Pay: $65,000.00" and the breakdown table contains rows for "Federal Tax" ($20,000.00), "State Tax" ($10,000.00), and "Other Deductions" ($5,000.00).
Clicking "Calculate" with "Gross Annual Salary" set to "0" shows the message "Gross salary must be greater than 0" and the result summary remains "Net Pay: $0.00".

After entering "Gross Annual Salary" as "42000" and clicking "Calculate", the chart area displays a segment labelled "Net Pay" with a value of "$31,500.00" and a segment labelled "Federal Tax" with a value of "$10,500.00".
Typing "abc" in the field labelled "Gross Annual Salary" and clicking "Calculate" shows the message "Enter a valid number" and the result summary remains "Net Pay: $0.00".
After setting "Gross Annual Salary" to "60000" and "Federal Tax" to "15000", clicking "Calculate" shows "Net Pay: $45,000.00" and the breakdown table row for "Federal Tax" displays "$15,000.00".

Reload keeps the last calculated values: after entering "Gross Annual Salary" as "50000" and clicking "Calculate", reloading the page still shows "Net Pay: $37,500.00" in the result summary and the breakdown row "Federal Tax" with "$12,500.00".
